info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Returns API provides a mechanism for retrieving detailed information about car rental reservation returns. This endpoint allows users to access data related to returns, ensuring they have the necessary insights regarding the status and history of their reservations. Typical consumers of this API include car rental companies and their fleet management systems, which use the information for operational insights and customer service. Whether it's for monitoring returns or processing customer feedback, this API supports efficient management of rental operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about returning reservations, including relevant return policies and procedures. It provides essential information necessary for users returning their bookings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify parameters for returning reservations. It contains relevant details that the server needs to process the return operation.

204.description: Request was successful, but there is no content to return.
